description: Change one setting of the user's Parfumo account: a notification or privacy toggle, or a website option, by the `field` name parfumo_get_settings returns. Private to the account. Gender, country and time zone go through parfumo_update_profile; the account language is not changed by this server. Parfumo answers the same whether the setting exists or not, so the tool reads the page again and returns the setting as it is after the call. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the request that would be made.

field.description: Name of the setting, as returned by parfumo_get_settings (e.g. "notifications_messages", "hide_followers").

value.description: New value: "true" / "false" for a toggle, the value or the label of an option for a choice.

name: parfumo_update_settings

SettingOption.description: One choice of a setting that takes a value from a list.

value.description: Value to pass to change the setting.

SettingOut.description: One setting with its current value.

field.description: Name of the setting: pass it to parfumo_update_settings.

options.description: Choices of a `choice` setting; omitted when there are more than 30 (use `options_of`).

options_total.description: Number of choices of a `choice` setting.

value.description: Current value; absent when the page does not mark the selected choice.

SettingsPage.description: The settings pages of an account.

oneOf.description: Website language and display, mailbox, shelves, Souk.

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when the write request was sent.

planned_requests.description: The write request sent, or that would be sent.

setting.description: The setting as Parfumo holds it after the call (before it in a dry run).
